comparison.objective: Selectively harvest ripe tomatoes at their knuckles; candidate commissions a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Compliant fruit grasping, bend-to-snap detachment, damage avoidance, and placement versus rigid-tool insertion, counterholding, fine rotation, and torque control.
comparison.success_condition: Ripe fruit safely in tray, green fruit and truss undamaged, no crushing or drops versus repeatable non-bottoming mechanical stops within published limits.
comparison.reason: This is a deformable/agricultural damage-sensitive manipulation task, not rigid mechanical adjustment; all four versions were read.
